name: Workspaces (end-4 style)
author: skylightlim
description: Per-workspace app icons with a Super-hold number reveal, in the style of end-4/dots-hyprland. Detects TUI and CLI apps running inside terminals, so yazi, btop and Claude Code show their own icon instead of the terminal's.

barWidget.description: Workspace slots showing the active app's icon, with a Super-hold number reveal.

schema.label: Show app icons
schema.description: Occupied workspaces show their biggest window's icon. Turn off for plain numbers.

schema.label: Tint icons to the bar colour
schema.description: Renders icons in the bar's foreground colour instead of their own. Ignored on light themes and transparent bars.

schema.label: Icon size multiplier
schema.description: Relative to the bar's default icon size. Try 1.25 for a taller bar.

schema.label: Super-hold before numbers appear
schema.description: Milliseconds. Hold Super to swap every slot to its workspace number; 0 reveals instantly.
